content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Campus Security Manager at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (IIM Kozhikode)
Consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 38,900/- (Including telephone allowance of Rs. 500/- per month)
Not below 35 years but not exceeding 55 years as on the last date for receiving application
IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O., Kunnamangalam, Kozhikode 673570

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following educational qualification and experience criteria: Educational Qualification: Graduation in any discipline (including graduate degree awarded for defence personnel - JCO's & equivalent need apply). Language and Technical Skills: Candidates should be able to write reports in English and have good communication skills in English, Hindi & Malayalam; basic knowledge in operating computers; and ability to monitor CCTV feeds. Experience: At least 15 years' experience in Defence/Para Military forces / Police / PSU/ Industrial Organization/ Educational Institution of which at least three years as a Security Officer / Supervisory Level in a large organization where 50 or more personnel were deployed. Desirable / Preferred: Candidate holding a Diploma in Fire Safety and Security Management; retired personnel who have served in CISF as an officer or JCO and equivalent ranks; ex-service personnel of Military/ Para Military Forces / Police department / PSU/ Industrial Organization having served in a Group A or Group B Posts; knowledge and practical handling of firefighting equipment's and emergency response; expertise in risk management, incident response, and regulatory compliance; and technical proficiency in modern security systems and tools.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 38,900/-, which includes a telephone allowance of Rs. 500/- per month. The engagement is purely on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, and further extensions will be subject to job requirements and performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Kozhikode Campus Security Manager
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at https://iimk.ac.in/ . Access the online application portal and submit applications online. Upload photograph, CV, certificates, and signature as per the format prescribed in the online portal. Ensure online submission is completed latest by 5:00 pm of 20.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates based on details submitted in the application, academic & professional profiles will be called for the selection process and interview. Time slots for interviews will be communicated by e-mail. Engagement is subject to verification of all certificates and experience at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Campus Security Manager position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is engaged purely on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, with further extensions subject to job requirements and performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply in terms of age and what is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be below 35 years and must not exceed 55 years of age as on the last date for receiving applications.

faq.question: Q3. Can retired personnel from CISF or ex-service personnel apply?
faq.answer: Yes, retired personnel who have served in CISF as an officer or JCO and equivalent ranks, as well as ex-service personnel from Military, Para Military Forces, Police department, PSU, or Industrial Organization who served in Group A or Group B posts, are listed under desirable/preferred qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Eligible applications are screened, and candidates are shortlisted based on the details submitted in their application, along with their academic and professional profiles.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 20.10.2026 latest by 5:00 p.m.
